jobs.title: Adult Education Instructor
jobs.description: Black River Technical College is seeking qualified applicants for the position of Adult Education Instructor located primarily on the Paragould Campus. Teaching at other locations may sometimes be required of the instructor. This position may require evening or weekend hours. The job is a full-time, twelve-month position. The College is committed to a quality work environment and experience by providing the following benefits in addition to compensation: COLA and/or bonuses are provided whenever fiscally responsible Eight hours of sick leave monthly after fulfilling all work hours in a pay period Eight hours of vacation leave monthly after fulfilling all work hours in a pay period Vacation leave increases according to years of service schedule Eight hours per calendar year of education leave A portion of health insurance premium paid by BRTC $20,000 life insurance policy with premium paid by BRTC 14% minimum retirement contribution from BRTC each pay period 11 paid State Holidays per calendar year if employed full time during the date of those Holidays Tuition Waiver for Employee and dependents to BRTC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Adult Education Instructor will teach Adult Basic Education, ESL, and GED courses. Subjects taught will include but not be limited to the GED test areas (literature, writing, social studies, science, and math) and adult basic education skill areas (language, math, and reading). The instructor may also be responsible for teaching ESL (English as a Second Language) classes, Distance and Virtual Learning, Integrated Education and Training, and workplace classes. In addition, the instructor will complete any professional development needed as determined by the Adult Education Division. Other responsibilities of the instructor include: administering the TABE assessment to determine individual skills and TABE post-tests to assess progress according to recommended guidelines, administering the GED Ready pre-test and making assignments or referrals based on the results, completing and maintaining appropriate student registration, attendance, and assessment records. SPECIAL SKILLS: Knowledge and experience using MS Word, Excel, Zoom, Go Meet (or another online meeting platform), and Canvas (or other open-source learning management platforms such as Moodle or Blackboard). The candidate must have the ability to be a self-starter and work remotely with students online. QUALIFICATIONS: The applicant must have a Bachelor's degree and possess a current Arkansas Teaching Certificate. In addition, Adult Education Certification is required within three years of the hire date. Applications will be taken until the position is filled. Interested candidates should submit a cover letter, resume, state application, and three references to: BLACK RIVER TECHNICAL COLLEGE Julie Edington, Executive Director of Human Resources P.O. Box 468 Pocahontas, AR 72455 Telephone (870) 248-4032 BRTC is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer BRTC is a Tobacco Free Campus

jobs.description: Assistant Professor Bookmark this Posting Print Preview | Apply for this Job Position Details Position Information Posting Number F0512025 Working Title Assistant Professor Department Org 365000 - Mathematics Why should you work at UCA? We are excited that you are considering joining the UCA Family—the faculty, staff, students and alumni—who make the University of Central Arkansas a great place to work!At the University of Central Arkansas, we value our employees striving to maintain a work-life balance. We realize that this affects the overall well-being of employees while learning to prioritize challenging work and the ability to make a difference. Participation in university-wide flexible work schedules may be available for certain positions. Training is provided on systems or job-specific software, and tools are available supporting professional and personal development. The benefits package allows you to customize your benefits to meet your current needs, with the ability to adjust them as your priorities change. This includes university contributions to health, dental, life and disability insurance, 80% tuition waivers for employees and their families, 12 official holidays, immediate leave accrual, and a retirement program with university contributions of 10% of employee salary. Also available are health and wellness incentives, as well as access to sports and cultural activities on campus for the family, free gym membership and equipment rentals. Position Summary The Department of Mathematics at the University of Central Arkansas invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Mathematics starting Fall 2026. We are seeking a candidate dedicated to teaching who also demonstrates a clear potential for research and a commitment to service. This position is governed by state and federal laws and agency/institution policy. Job Duties and Responsibilities A faculty member in Mathematics typically will have 12 hours of teaching load in each Fall and Spring semester. The faculty member will be expected to teach a variety of mathematics courses as well as lower-division service courses (E.g. Calculus and Elementary Statistics). Currently, most classes are in person, but some are occasionally offered online to meet the needs of our students.Our faculty are expected to strive to improve their teaching, maintain an active research program leading to peer-reviewed publications, and be willing to involve students in their research. In addition, participation in departmental, college, and community service is an essential expectation of the role. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities In addition to possessing strong analytical skills, the successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to deliver effective instruction and assess student performance, as well as engage both undergraduate and graduate students in research. Familiarity in designing and organizing courses, interdisciplinary collaboration experience, and grant writing skills would be beneficial. Skills Considered Essential for Success -Knowledge of the organization and administration of higher education.-Knowledge of state, federal, and university rules, regulations and procedures.-Ability to work in a diverse and dynamic environment.-Ability to work collaboratively and independently with common goals as a part of a team.-Ability to make sound judgments.-Effective interpersonal communication, writing, and organizational abilities.-Civility in all interactions.-Demonstrate effective follow-up. Required Education and/or Experience The position requires a Doctorate (PhD) in Mathematics or a closely related field. Candidates with specializations in applied mathematics, data science, or statistics are strongly encouraged to apply. Preferred Education and/or Experience Prior teaching experience at the university level is preferred, including teaching assistantships, guest lectures, or teaching positions.A strong background in conducting original research focusing on applied mathematics, engineering, statistics, and/or data science is preferred, e.g. publication in a reputable journal, conference, poster presentation, etc. License(s)/Certifications (Required or Preferred) University, Campus, and Community Description Thank you for your interest in employment at the University of Central Arkansas.Founded in 1907, UCA has an enrollment of more than 10,000 students and employs over 1,300 full-time employees. The university offers more than 85 undergraduate and 59 graduate certificate and degree programs, including doctoral programs in five disciplines. UCA is proud of its tradition of teaching excellence and its contributions in research, scholarship, and creative activities. Desired start date 08/16/2026 Will this position be Onsite, Remote, or Hybrid? Position Summary The University of Central Arkansas (UCA) is seeking a full-time, tenure-track Assistant Professor (9-month appointment) to join the School of Nursing. This on-campus role is designed for a doctorally prepared (DNP or PhD) Family Nurse Practitioner who will shape the next generation of nursing professionals. The successful candidate will lead innovative educational programs, conduct scholarly research, and contribute to a supportive, inclusive academic environment. Learn more at: www.uca.edu/nursing Job Duties and Responsibilities This tenure track position focuses on teaching, curriculum development, assessment and evaluation, collaboration and mentorship. The faculty member will facilitate student learning, engage in research and scholarship, focus on continuous professional development and provide institutional, professional and community service. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities As a tenure-track faculty, you will translate intricate clinical data into digestible, evidence-based instruction. You will ground your teaching in the current realities of healthcare policy and ethics, ensuring students are equipped to navigate the systemic challenges of modern healthcare.Key Responsibilities: Curriculum Innovation: Design and deliver high-impact programs utilizing active learning and high-fidelity simulations. Mentorship & Leadership: Guide novice nurses and colleagues through the nuances of clinical judgment and professional identity. Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Thrive within academic teams to drive institutional excellence and adapt to evolving accreditation standards. Scholarly Contribution: Advance the profession through reflective practice, original research, and advocacy for healthcare equity. Qualifications & Skills: Clinical Mastery: Advanced knowledge of nursing science and delivery systems. Instructional Excellence: Proven ability to apply educational theory to clinical complexity. Dynamic Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to lead and inspire. Adaptability: A commitment to lifelong learning and the integration of emerging healthcare technologies. Required Education and/or Experience The candidate MUST have: 1) Doctoral degree (PhD in Nursing or DNP from a nationally accredited institution. 2) APRN certification and licensure as a Family Nurse Practitioner and current unencumbered RN license. 3) Significant clinical experience in nursing practice. 4) Prior experience teaching nursing students at the undergraduate and/or graduate level, with a strong understanding of pedagogical principles and instructional methodologies. Candidates who are ABD or who have 3 or less semesters left to complete the doctoral degree will be considered.Must have all clinical requirements mandated by the clinical agencies used for student clinical experiences. jobs.description: Math Instructor Daphne Perkins has retired from Black River Technical College (BRTC) after 22 years of service. “Daphne has been a steady and thoughtful presence in our department, and her impact goes well beyond the classroom,” Travis Harris, math instructor, said. “She brought consistency, a strong commitment to students, and a leadership style that helped keep things grounded.” Perkins was recognized at a retirement reception and at an end-of-the-year celebration for BRTC faculty and staff. jobs.title: Dean of Students' Office
jobs.description: Dean of Students Office The Dean of Students is committed to helping all students at ASU-Beebe reach their fullest potential. Through supervising the Office of Student Life, the Dean of Students collaborates with a team of faculty & staff that provide a variety of student support services along with opportunities for leadership experience, engaging programming, and specialized resources.The Office of Student Life consists of several specialized programs, including Dining & Food Services, Disability Services, Emergency & Care Services, Facilities & Events Services, Housing & Campus Living, ID Card Office, Intramural & Recreation, New Student Programs, Parent & Family Programs, Student Activities, Student Leadership Programs, Student Conduct, Student Organizations, Testing Center, Vanguard Mascot, and Vanguard Volunteers. Emergency & Care Services The Dean of Students helps students and their families during difficult or emergency situations. Assistance includes outreach, advocacy, intervention, support and referrals to relevant campus and community resources. Please note our office does not provide counseling services. Learn More about Emergency Services Academic & Community Standards At the ASU-Beebe, we want students' continued education to be successful and engaging, and we care about the safety and well-being of our campus community. With this in mind, the ASU-Beebe has established clear academic & community standards through a document entitled the Student Code of Conduct, which communicates the collective expectations of members of the Vanguard community.The Dean of Students is responsible for the administration college's s academic & community standards and facilitation of the Student Conduct Process. Aiming to provide a safe and equitable campus community, potential violations of the Student Code of Conduct are investigated and adjudicated through a process designed to foster self-reflection, promote civility, and encourage personal responsibility. Acces Student Conduct Resources Student Leadership Programs The Dean of Students is proud to provide a variety of formats for students to participate in developing the leader within. Whether participating in student government, joining a student orgainzation, finding real-work leadership opportunities on campus, or attending one of our many workshops, there is room for everyone to develop leadership skills while attending ASU-Beebe. More About Leadership Opportunities Cocurricular Learning & Assessment It is the mission of the Office of Student Life to foster a campus environment that cultivates student learning through developing innovative co-curricular programming that enables students to become citizen leaders and engaged scholars within their community. Our educational priority is to enable residents to become citizen leaders and students as engaged scholars within their community. Students living on campus at ASU-Beebe will benefit from an environment that encourages learning through scholarship, citizenship, and leadership.Students at ASU-Beebe have the opportunity to participate in numerous experiences that promote learning. As the Office of Student Life assessed what experiences and outcomes students should gain while participating in campus life, four broad categories were identified which will serve as the center of campus life programming. Just like the arch which has historically stood in the center of the ASU-Beebe campus, we have labeled the outcomes ARCH, or:Academic & College SuccessRespect for Self & OthersCommunity & Leadership EngagementHealth & Personal WellnessAll campus life events and programming are designed to provide opportunities for students to engage with the ARCH Campus Life Curriculum's 16 cocurricular learning outcomes. The Dean of Students is responsible for assessing cocurricular learning for student life programming. Prohibition of Campus Hazing A learning community must be one where students can engage with peers, faculty, and staff in a safe environment, free of intimidation or threat of marginalization. As a result, and in compliance with state and federal laws, ASU-Beebe strictly prohibits hazing in any form. An individual’s participation in our learning community through registered student organizations, programs, or activities should be supportive and enhance, not undermine, the academic experience at ASU-Beebe. The initiation, admission, or membership of a registered student organization, program, or activity affiliated with the college should be one based on the community’s collective expectations of civility, respect, morality, and ethical behavior. Important Info Report an IncidentASU-Beebe is dedicated to providing a safe, secure learning environment for our campus community. You can help by reporting student concerns, student conduct violations, sexual misconduct or other potential threats to campus safety. File Incident Report.Schedule an AppointmentInvolvement in Student Life is an important part of your college experience; and the Student Life Office ensures you don't miss the college atmosphere while attending. Schedule an Appointment.Student CommunicationJoin the mailing list from the Dean of Student Office for regular updates on activities and news. You can also view the latest communications in case you missed them! Click Here.
